description:
Activate Kozilek's Channeler by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Kozilek's Channeler.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Kozilek's Channeler.
Repeat.
